evidence.note: מִלְכָּה supplies the name of Nahor’s wife and is followed by בַּת הָרָן, “daughter of Haran.”
Vashti bears the title הַמַּלְכָּה, “the queen,” illustrating the related noun מַלְכָּה.

name: מִלְכָּה
summary: Genesis 11:29 names Milcah as Nahor’s wife and Haran’s daughter. Her name is related to מַלְכָּה, “queen.”
